title: M5-T173 part B1 (M5-T191) - page-4 footprint renderers: the engine's floor-1 plate drawn and dimensioned as an illustrative footprint on the site close frame (maps) and the kit report-frame fallback; opt-in, every other frame byte-identical
objective: Renderer level only (part W threads the data). (1) NEW maps/placed_footprint.py: translate the results-local floor-1 plate ring onto the map lot by constraint_overlay.overlay_offset (import only); validate it (finite, magnitude at most 1e9, 3 to 1000 vertices, non-zero area, every vertex inside or on the subject outline within 0.05 ft); draw it in the new kind 'illustrative_footprint' (legend 'Illustrative building footprint'); two dimensions, the back edge (width) and one depth edge, with their dimension lines on the lot-interior side so they never meet the lot-edge dimensions, each label the edge's own length, at least 8.5 pt, reusing close_frame_dimensions helpers by import. Invalid input or an unplaceable label draws NOTHING of the footprint (no exception, never shrunk or partial). (2) maps/site_context_plan.py, frame 'close' only (at most +15 SLOC; the file is 611 SLOC): accept placed_footprint and call (1); not_placed_legend stays True only when placed_footprint is None. (3) maps/__init__.py render_site_context_plan(..., placed_footprint=None) forwards it. (4) kit/styles.py: one new ShapeStyle 'illustrative_footprint'. (5) kit/site_plan.py frame 'report' only: the floor-1 plate in kind 'illustrative_footprint' (not the 'Residential' use kind) with the same two dimensions. No clearance and no tax-map figure is drawn anywhere: a clearance is neither a document number nor an edge length (C-4) and measured on the drawing it reads 35.32 ft against the document's 35.31 ft; part W prints the document's statement.
business_reason: Audit 2026-10-15c section 3: page 4 says 'No building placed' although the engine places Building B (DB-284; DB-227 building part). At e026a391 the kit fallback page 4 already draws the plate as 'Residential' while page 5 says 'Worked out; not drawn'.
